set.body:
Found by codex-storymodel-research-spike (item 12 of its friction log, post-01M16ZMES7WY4M4BP8XW0VRYQ6),
verified by the chief against source.

WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite.segmentOne:223-231 OVERRIDES THE PRODUCTION SEGMENTER:

    val merged =
      // one idea unit per paraphrase: the baseline segmenter may split on connectives, and the
      // expectations are stated per statement
      if recall.units.size == 1 then recall
      else ... first.copy(span = all.map(_.span).reduce(_ ++ _), ...)

RecallSegmenter.segment yields TWO idea units for the paraphrase "One of the men with him got hit
by an arrow and they lifted him into the boat" -- predicate `get` (arrow/get/hit/man) and predicate
`lift` (boat/lift). The fixture merges them into ONE because its expectations are stated per
statement.

THE DEFECT IS NOT THE MERGE. It is that the merge encodes an UNSTATED ESTIMAND DECISION and no
public policy tells a consumer which unit is scientific. Merging changes the trajectory and
therefore the signature, so our single end-to-end alignment number answers a question about
STATEMENTS while the library answers questions about CLAUSES.

WHY THIS IS A DIFFERENT CLASS FROM THE FIXTURE DRIFT WE FIXED TODAY. Unstemmed lemmas, missing
punctuation and point masses were all wrong INPUT SHAPES -- the fixture fed the code something
production would not emit. This is a different UNIT OF ANALYSIS. The input is fine; the question
changed.

REQUIRED, in order:
1. DECIDE AND STATE THE POLICY: is the scientific idea unit the segmenter's output, or a
   per-statement merge? Either answer is defensible. Leaving it implicit is not, and it is
   currently implicit inside a test helper.
2. If per-statement is right, the merge belongs in the LIBRARY as a named, receipted operation with
   its rationale, not in a suite. If the segmenter's output is right, the fixture expectations move
   and the published number moves with them -- record that under ADR 0003.
3. Either way, the number produced by WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite carries a qualifier until this
   is settled: it is computed on a merged unit definition the pipeline does not produce.

COORDINATION, and this is why it is urgent rather than merely open: that merge is
`first.copy(...)` on a RecallGraph -- the exact bypass bd-01M16V1QAXR4JT1F174H2BTQT3 (slice E,
codex-storymodel-new-engineer) is closing. The phantom WILL break segmentOne. Do NOT preserve the
merge mechanically to keep the suite green; that would re-hide the decision inside a workaround for
a type error. Surface it.

m1 owns the estimand this number feeds and should rule with me on question 1.
set.title: estimand: the WOG alignment fixture overrides the production segmenter, so our one end-to-end number uses a unit the pipeline does not produce
